name: Prakash Bhat
abstract_title: Quantum Subsystem Retro-causality in Mixed-Dimensional Spacetime (MST) as a Basis for Conscious Experience
abstract: MatterSpaceTime (MST) Theory proposes a unified ontological framework where matter, space, and time are not separate entities but mutually constraining aspects of a single mixed-dimensional manifold whose dimensionality can vary locally. This framework provides a natural setting for understanding how quantum behavior at the subsystem level can give rise to irreversible macroscopic phenomena while still permitting limited retro-causal effects.
